name: MCPJungle
summary: Self-hosted MCP gateway: register MCP servers once and expose them to Claude, Cursor, Codex or custom agents through a single endpoint, with tool groups and access control.
description: Use it locally for a personal setup or as shared team infrastructure with centralized discovery, access control and observability. Optional tool groups expose only selected tools to a client. Latest release 0.4.6 (2026-08-02).
